source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Enable the listed EDKII error-injection and ADDDC Sparing settings, install a 64 GB x4 DIMM configuration, boot Windows, run Intel ITP/Cscripts `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(runTime, adddc, adddcType, plus1, socket, mc, ch, adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False)`, and verify normal operation, correctable slot attribution, both fault indicators off and `sparing_harasser PASSED`.
procedure_facts: Verify the recipe and clear or delimit logs.
Apply six EDKII unlock/error-injection settings plus ADDDC Sparing Enabled.
Install the required 64 GB x4 DIMM population and deploy Intel ITP.
Boot Windows, start a Cscript log, halt, capture `mc.dimminfo()`, execute one DeviceSparingHarasser invocation, then resume.
criteria_facts: BMC identifies the correctable DIMM slot.
The corresponding DIMM lightpath remains off.
uEFI SEL identifies the slot when supported.
source_conflicts: The source explicitly boots Windows but its generic post-test examples include Linux `dmesg` and `syslog`; the required native OS evidence path is not defined.

The title says rank-level operation with plus1, while the shown invocation exposes no explicit rank argument and provides no concrete values or semantics for `runTime`, `adddc`, `adddcType`, `plus1`, `socket`, `mc` or `ch`.
missing_source_information: Exact supported platform/stepping and memory-controller topology.
Signed 64 GB x4 part, rank/population and logical-to-physical slot map.
Exact harasser argument values, units, semantics, timeout and target coverage.
Whether `plus1` is a literal value, mode or recipe-derived setting, and how rank selection occurs.
Expected Windows/BMC/uEFI signatures, evidence windows and restoration state.

original_test_intent.statement: Exercise the platform-approved rank-level Intel ADDDC sparing harasser with the recipe's plus1 behavior on the approved 64 GB x4 memory population and verify the harness PASS, correctable physical-slot reporting, no fault-light assertion, normal system operation and restoration.
must_preserve: Advanced RAS rank variant with plus1, not the adjacent no-plus1 or bank variants.
64 GB x4 DIMM requirement and ADDDC Sparing Enabled.
Windows execution and the exact DeviceSparingHarasser API shape.
One bounded approved run unless the owner defines a larger target matrix.
Cscript `sparing_harasser PASSED`, slot-specific BMC evidence, conditional uEFI evidence and both LED-off criteria.
30/30 minutes as source planning estimates, not invented runtime or timeout.
must_not_infer: A numeric/Boolean value for `plus1`, target rank, controller/channel or `runTime`.
That every Intel server supports this mode or the same population.
That a Linux dmesg/EDAC tail is valid evidence for the Windows run.
That `sparing_harasser PASSED` alone establishes all source acceptance criteria.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 preserves the plus1 rank variant, physical x4 population, manual BIOS/ITP boundary, harness PASS and recovery, but confines the Agent to evidence collection and adds Linux dmesg/EDAC evidence to a Windows procedure.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 treats provider-controlled setup and approval as proof that the core harness cannot be automated, does not resolve the missing rank/plus1 argument semantics, and allows an incompatible OS evidence path.

related_records: Reliability row 24 is the adjacent Advanced RAS Rank without plus1 variant; rows around this case include distinct bank, device and sparing recipes.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The exact XLSX row controls the variant. Adjacent same-family records are comparison evidence only and cannot supply missing parameters.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify the hybrid workflow from MANUAL ONLY to REQUIRES: qualified staff must establish the x4 population, BIOS state and physical observations, while an authorized Agent can execute the exact bounded Cscript harasser and collect/correlate evidence after the recipe resolves plus1/rank targeting and the Windows-native log path.

conditions_present: The source identifies the intended harasser API, ADDDC BIOS setting, Windows environment, 64 GB x4 population class and six acceptance observations.
missing: Platform-specific rank/population map; exact argument values and semantics; supported ITP/Cscripts build; native Windows event source; expected records and timing; approval, operator, recovery and restoration plan.
provider: Platform memory owner supplies population/rank/slot and final-state maps.
Intel/ODM FAE supplies and signs the proprietary harasser recipe and expected event interpretation.
Lab owner supplies the dedicated SUT, qualified operator, authorization and recovery window.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory CPU, memory controllers, DIMM SPD/part/serial/rank organization and current BIOS/BMC/Windows versions.
Export existing Windows Event Log, BMC and available uEFI records without clearing them.
Verify the package hash/API documentation, evidence storage, OOB console and recovery prerequisites without attaching ITP or halting the SUT.
prohibited_until_resolved: DIMM movement, BIOS changes, log clearing, ITP attachment, halt, harasser execution, reset, power cycle, retry or restoration.
closure_evidence: Signed recipe maps every argument and rank/slot target, defines plus1 semantics, expected events, timeout and completion.
Approved package/hash and Windows-native evidence query are staged.
Operator, ESD/power, go/no-go, recovery and restoration approvals are recorded.

revision_candidate.test_name: Intel ADDDC Advanced-RAS Rank Harasser with Recipe-Defined plus1
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved rank-level ADDDC sparing harasser with the recipe-defined plus1 behavior on the specified 64 GB x4 DIMM population and verify the complete correctable-event, indicator, health and harness-PASS criteria.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the Intel platform/stepping, BIOS/BMC/firmware, Windows build, 64 GB x4 DIMM population and ITP/Cscripts release explicitly covered by the signed FAE recipe.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The one rank/slot/controller/channel target or explicit target matrix named by the recipe. Preserve `adjacent=True`, `debug=False` and `skipSelfCheck=False`; do not substitute the no-plus1, bank, device, x8, UCE or other neighboring ADDDC variant. Treat 30/30 minutes as planning estimates only.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed 64 GB x4 part/population/rank/slot map; platform identity; exact values, types, units and semantics for `runTime`, `adddc`, `adddcType`, `plus1`, `socket`, `mc` and `ch`; supported ITP/Cscripts build/hash/client; seven BIOS values and restore plan; Windows-native/BMC/uEFI expected records and slot encoding; LED observation window; timeout/go-no-go; approval and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve and hash Windows/BMC/uEFI baselines before any approved clear or use an approved timestamp marker. A qualified operator powers down and establishes the signed x4 population, then applies the seven BIOS settings. Boot the supported Windows image and verify `mc.dimminfo()` against the physical map. After target-specific approval, an authorized Agent or FAE opens a unique full ITP log, halts the exact target, runs one exact `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` invocation with all signed values and resumes immediately. Collect unfiltered harness, Windows-native, BMC, conditional uEFI, LED and health evidence, then restore the signed final state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact rank/slot/argument and plus1 semantics resolved; supported platform and package verified; dedicated idle recovery-capable SUT; safe power/ESD controls; qualified physical observer; Windows/BMC/uEFI baselines retained; console/OOB/recovery proven; storage/time synchronized; every physical, BIOS, log-clear, halt/injection, reset and restoration action approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Platform and tool identity/hash; signed population/rank/slot and argument map; x4 DIMM SPD/part/serial plus photos; BIOS before/during/after; baseline/clear audit; full `mc.dimminfo()`; exact harasser invocation and unfiltered log containing `sparing_harasser PASSED`; Windows-native event evidence required by the recipe; raw BMC record decoded to the target slot; uEFI SEL slot record when supported and required; synchronized front-panel and target-DIMM LED-off evidence; health, anomalies, recovery and restored-final-state proof.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The platform/FAE-signed rank-with-plus1 ADDDC recipe for this exact configuration, constrained by the source criteria: normal system operation, correctable target-slot BMC record, both fault indicators off, uEFI slot record when supported and `sparing_harasser PASSED`.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Critical memory fault injection on a dedicated SUT only. Do not infer plus1/rank values, reuse a neighboring variant, guess controller or slot indices, use unknown/non-x4 DIMMs, move live hardware, mix Linux evidence into the Windows run, expose secrets, truncate/filter the harness log, leave the target halted, auto-loop, retry after failure or continue after wrong severity/slot, LED assertion or instability.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The memory owner approves the module/population and any relocation; the FAE approves the exact arguments, package and target; a qualified operator performs ESD-safe hardware/BIOS work and observes LEDs. Log clear, ITP attach, halt/harasser/resume, any next target, recovery and final restoration require the signed go/no-go policy.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Only qualified staff perform DIMM installation/relocation, BIOS setup, physical LED observation and exceptional recovery. Once those conditions and the exact recipe are established, an authorized Agent may run the bounded Cscript invocation and collect/correlate Windows, BMC, uEFI and harness evidence; the engineer retains final anomaly and PASS/FAIL judgment.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong population/target/argument, failure to resume, missing harness PASS, error storm, uncorrectable or misattributed event, LED assertion, crash/no-boot or persistent fault, stop, preserve all evidence, use approved OOB recovery, power down before hardware work and restore only through the signed BIOS/population plan before any separately approved rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved plus1/rank/argument semantics or Windows log path; population/tool/BIOS mismatch; missing approval, observer, baseline, recovery or evidence capacity; failed `mc.dimminfo()` mapping; halt/resume or harasser failure; missing `sparing_harasser PASSED`; wrong severity/slot; front-panel or target-DIMM LED assertion; missing/mismatched BMC record, or uEFI SEL record when declared supported and required; crash/reset/hang, error storm, thermal/power/memory instability; or failed restoration/final boot.

identified_defects: V2 overstates the irreducibly manual scope: the physical/BIOS/visual stages are manual, but the approved Cscript invocation and evidence collection can be automated after explicit handoff.
The source and V2 leave all harasser arguments unresolved and do not explain how the rank claim maps to an API without an explicit rank parameter.
The source generic examples and V2 add Linux dmesg/EDAC evidence despite an explicit Windows boot.
V2 does not separate the harness PASS from the independent slot, LED, health and conditional uEFI acceptance criteria.
reason_for_change: Represent the actual hybrid automation capability without reducing physical or fault-injection controls, and prevent execution from guessed plus1/rank arguments or incompatible Linux evidence.

new_technical_evidence.title: Querying the System Event Log for Hardware Error Events
new_technical_evidence.supports: Windows WHEA hardware error events are queried from Windows Event Log providers; a Linux dmesg/EDAC tail is not a native substitute.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The testcase owner has not specified whether a Windows WHEA record is mandatory or its expected fields.

new_technical_evidence.title: Intel Xeon Processor Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability Technical Paper
new_technical_evidence.applicability: General Intel Xeon DDR5 RAS terminology only; platform applicability must be confirmed
new_technical_evidence.supports: Intel describes ADDDC as Adaptive Double Device Data Correction, a memory reliability feature invoked for impending device failure; it does not establish this proprietary harasser's plus1/rank argument values.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Exact platform generation, plus1 behavior, harasser semantics and expected records remain FAE-controlled.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-System RAS-00746-V003
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only the Advanced RAS Rank with plus1 variant
new_technical_evidence.supports: The exact BIOS settings, 64 GB x4 requirement, Windows/ITP sequence, API shape and six acceptance criteria.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: All argument values, rank selection, event formats and restoration details are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Defines the plus1 value and rank targeting as recipe inputs, not title-derived assumptions.
Separates manual DIMM/BIOS/visual work from automatable approved Cscript execution and evidence correlation.
Uses Windows-native evidence and makes uEFI SEL conditional on declared support and requirement.
Excludes adjacent no-plus1, bank, device and other ADDDC variants.
resolved_blockers: Package, recipe, approvals and manual setup are provider-closable prerequisites rather than evidence that the core workflow is permanently non-automatable.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits the signed population/rank/argument map, Windows event requirement, exact package, expected events/timing, operator, authorization and recovery plan.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 accurately models the hybrid workflow, closes the rank/plus1 targeting gap, removes incompatible Linux evidence from the Windows run and prevents `sparing_harasser PASSED` from being mistaken for complete acceptance.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation recovered the exact rank-with-plus1 variant, recipe-defined argument semantics, 64 GB x4/manual boundaries, one authorized invocation per explicit target, Windows-native evidence, independent harness/slot/LED/health criteria and restoration. It did not infer missing values or treat harness PASS as complete acceptance.
